about.name: Ezz El-Din Emad
about.title: Machine Learning Engineer in Training | Computer Vision & LLM Systems
about.bio: Computing & Data Science student at Alexandria University who builds machine learning systems end to end — from data preparation and model comparison to evaluation, quantization and a deployed interface. Recent work spans computer vision on GTSRB, a bilingual agentic RAG assistant for medical information, and job-market analytics. Comfortable across Python, SQL, TensorFlow, PyTorch and scikit-learn, with deployment through Streamlit, FastAPI and TensorFlow Lite.

skills._comment: Skills grouped by category. Each skill has: name, icon (optional URL from devicons CDN).

projects.title: Traffic Sign Recognition — 43 Classes
projects.description: Team capstone building an end-to-end GTSRB classifier: benchmarked classical ML against deep learning, then quantized the best model to TensorFlow Lite — the Int8 build is 254 KB and runs at 1.9 ms per image (519 images/s) at 97.08% Top-1. My scope: EDA and data preparation, classical baselines (HOG+SVM 63.2%), transfer learning with MobileNetV3-Small (90.8% Top-1), the evaluation suite (Top-5, robustness, latency, throughput), Grad-CAM explanations and the Streamlit app.

projects.title: Medical Agentic RAG Assistant
projects.description: Bilingual (Arabic/English) Telegram assistant answering medical questions with evidence-grounded retrieval: LLM query routing, Qdrant vector search with multilingual E5 embeddings, relevance gating, clarification loops and input/output guardrails, plus clinic booking workflows with persistent state. Deployed as FastAPI webhooks on Vercel.

projects.title: HR Employee Attrition Analysis Dashboard
projects.description: Analyzed 1,470 employees to identify high-risk groups and retention factors. Discovered that Sales Representatives had 39.8% attrition and overtime workers 30.5%. Used DAX correlation analysis to uncover 5 key retention factors contributing to 16.12% overall attrition rate.

projects.title: Fashion MNIST Classifier
projects.description: PyTorch classifier for 10-class clothing images: compared a baseline against a wide-and-deep network, then ran automated hyperparameter search with Optuna (3 hidden layers, 86 units, Adam) to reach 89.37% test accuracy. Served through an interactive Streamlit dashboard with live predictions and metrics.

projects.title: IoT Smart Pet Care System
projects.description: Led a team to develop an automated pet feeding system using ESP32 with IR sensors for food detection and water level monitoring. Implemented real-time MQTT communication with Supabase and designed a Flutter mobile interface for remote control and monitoring.

projects.title: Job Market Analysis
projects.description: Scraped and processed 8,000+ job listings from Bayt.com across Egypt and Saudi Arabia through an automated SQL pipeline, uncovering seasonal hiring trends and high-growth sectors. Built 12 interactive visualizations per market with Plotly and Seaborn, plus a cross-market comparison.
